information: Competitor limit: 160. Online registration is a flat $18.75 fee and closes a week before the event. **You may also register at the competition day, with a cost of $20.** Tentative events: 4x4x4 Cube Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Cube Blindfolded. Competition held in the Ridge View Room.
